subject: DevCon NA Sponsorship — breakout session proposal
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@devcon.co>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: DevCon Events <partnerships@devcon.co>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: DevCon NA sponsorship — breakout session proposal

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. Based on what we discussed, I wanted to put a concrete option on the table that might give Redwood higher on-site visibility while keeping the keynote slot flexible.

Proposal summary:
- 30-minute breakout session during Peak Track (Fri 11:30) — confirmed speaker slot, AV, and recording.
- Visibility credit: in lieu of keynote, we can offer a $15,000 marketing credit (applied to registration lists, pre-event emails, and sponsored content) + priority demo-pod placement near main hall.
- Logo placement: medium logo on main stage scrolling banner, large logo on Peak Track page, and one dedicated pre-event email to registrants (8k targeted).
- Booth: standard 10x10 with option to upgrade to 6ft demo table near demo alley (subject to availability).

I've attached an updated sponsorship annex (v3) with the deliverables and proposed language for recording rights and attendee lists. We can also route this to DocuSign once you're comfortable.

Can you confirm: a) whether the $15k visibility credit is acceptable as a benefit in lieu of a keynote, and b) whether Redwood needs any changes to recording/attendee sharing terms?

If it helps, I can hold the breakout slot for 72 hours while you discuss internally.

Best,
Sonia Patel
Partnerships Lead, DevCon Events
sonia@devcon.co
+1 415-555-0123

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DevCon NA sponsorship — breakout session proposal

Hi Sonia,

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. Quick internal notes and next steps from our side:

1) Visibility credit: the $15k credit sounds reasonable, but we need clarity on the redemption mechanics (what counts toward the credit: emails, sponsored content, on-site extras?). Please list line items the credit can be applied against in the annex.

2) Breakout session: we like the 30-minute slot, but two asks: a) we require guaranteed recording and an export of attendee opt-ins for the session (CSV) within 7 business days post-event; b) we need clarity on whether you permit light product demos during the session (slides + 5 min demo ok?).

3) Booth/demo-pod: priority placement is great. We will confirm footprint preference after we see the visual mockup. Please confirm the upgrade cost and whether the demo pod includes power and a small monitor.

4) Legal: routing the annex to our legal team — can you confirm DocuSign readiness and who is the signatory on your side? We have a 10-business-day turnaround target for sponsorship addendum review.

Camila, can you please pre-check AV requests and the standard recording file delivery SLA? Aditya, flagging for pricing approval if we accept the visibility credit mix.

Sonia — if you can send a short line-item list for the visibility credit and a DocuSign link, we can triage this and get back within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 646-555-0198
From: Sonia Patel <sonia@devcon.co>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DevCon NA sponsorship — breakout session proposal

Hi Grace (and team),

Thanks for the quick response. Below are the line-items for the $15k visibility credit and answers to your questions:

Visibility credit breakdown (total $15,000):
- Dedicated pre-event email to targeted registrants: $6,000
- Sponsored blog post + newsletter feature: $3,000
- Priority demo-pod placement (in-kind) valued at $4,000
- Social amplification package (3 organic posts + 1 paid boost): $2,000

Recording & attendee lists:
- We will provide the session recording (MP4) and an attendee opt-in CSV within 5 business days after the event.
- Product demo: light demos are permitted (slides + up to 5 minutes live demo). We ask that demos avoid competitive pricing screens or production credentials.

Booth/demo-pod specifics:
- Demo pod includes power, basic AV (screen + HDMI), and one bar-height stool. Upgrade cost to adjacent 6ft demo table: $1,250 (one-time).

DocuSign & signatory:
- Annex is DocuSign-ready. Signatory will be DevCon Events, Inc. (Kendra Martinez, Director of Partnerships). DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/placeholder/abc123

I'll reattach the annex with the credit line-items included and the mockups. We can hold the breakout slot through end of day Monday (16 Nov) if you need the time.

Best,
Sonia

Attachment: DevCon_Sponsorship_Annex_v3.pdf (updated with credit breakdown)
Attachment: sponsor-visual-mockup.png
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@devcon.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DevCon NA sponsorship — breakout session proposal

Sonia — thanks for the breakdown and updated annex. We reviewed internally and are prepared to move forward with the breakout slot plus the visibility credit, with a couple of contract adjustments we need in the sponsorship addendum before signature:

1) Recording and attendee data: please confirm the attendee CSV will be limited to registrants who explicitly opted into sponsor communications and that the CSV schema includes: first name, last name, company, title, email, and opt-in flag. Add that to the annex.

2) Cancellation/No-show protection: we request a clause that provides a 50% credit/refund of the sponsorship fee (or proportional visibility credit) if DevCon cancels the breakout session or removes sponsor visibility less than 7 days prior to the session start.

3) Usage rights: we need explicit permission to use the provided recording and slides for our own marketing (webinars and gated content) in perpetuity; please add a clause granting Redwood a non-exclusive license for those materials.

If you can add those three items to the annex and re-send the DocuSign link, we can aim to have our legal team sign within the 10-business-day window. Grace — thanks for routing the AV check, Camila.

Assuming those items are acceptable, we'll take the standard 10x10 booth + priority demo-pod (no upgrade for now). Please confirm the final sponsorship fee after the $15k visibility credit is factored in and the invoice recipient for DevCon.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Sales — Redwood Inference
